body.description: Text of the note, up to 10000 characters.

org_id.description:
The organization unit of the note; you need `notes.write` there. Omit when you work in
one unit only (or for the whole tenant); otherwise `notes.org_required`.

title.description: Title, 1 to 200 characters; unique among your notes.

org_id.description: The organization unit the note belongs to; the root unit has the id of the tenant.

title.description: Unique among the notes of one user.

data.description: The items of this page, in the requested order.

org_id.description: The organization unit the note belongs to; the root unit has the id of the tenant.

title.description: Unique among the notes of one user.

data.description: The items of this page, in the requested order.

items.description: A record that changed: the record as it is now, or a deletion mark.

cursor.description:
Keep the `cursor` of the last change you applied and send it back to get the changes after
it. It may lag a few seconds behind, so the latest changes can come again: apply them
again, they carry the current record.

org_id.description: The organization unit the note belongs to; the root unit has the id of the tenant.

title.description: Unique among the notes of one user.

deleted.description: `true`: the record was deleted, or you no longer may read it — remove it from the device.

version.description:
Version of the record (`ETag`): send it in `If-Match` when changing it. Left out when
`deleted`.

Pagination.description: How to get the next page.

limit.description: The limit that was applied to this page.

next_cursor.description:
Pass this as `cursor` to get the next page. `null` means this is the last
page.

total.description:
Number of items matching the filters, over all pages. Only on the first page of a request
with `count=true`; left out otherwise.

Problem.description: An error, as RFC 9457 Problem Details. Branch on `code`; show `detail` to people.

code.description:
Stable machine-readable identifier of the problem. Branch on this, never
on `detail`.

current.description:
For `precondition_failed` on endpoints that say so: the record as it is now on the server,
in the same shape as reading it. Its version is in the `ETag` header: merge your change
into it and send that `ETag` in `If-Match`.

detail.description: Human-readable explanation of what went wrong and how to fix it.

errors.description: One entry per invalid input field. Present only for validation problems.

reason.description:
Finer, stable reason for some codes, documented with the code — e.g. for a refused link
token: `expired`, `used` or `unknown`.

status.description: The HTTP status code, repeated in the body.

title.description: The standard phrase for the HTTP status, e.g. `Not Found`.

type.description: Always `about:blank`: the problem is identified by `code`, not by a URI.

ProblemField.description: One invalid field of the request.

code.description: Stable identifier of the kind of problem: `required`, `length`, `range`…

detail.description: What the value must look like.
detail.example: must be between 1 and 50 characters long

UpdateNoteRequest.description: Changes to a note. Omitted fields stay as they are.

get.description:
Requires `notes.read`; its scope decides which notes you see (`own`: yours; `unit`, `subtree`:
notes of your unit, or of it and the units below; `tenant`: all). Newest first unless
`order=asc`.

parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return, 1 to 200. Defaults to 50.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Where to continue: the `next_cursor` of the previous page. Omit for the first page. Treat the value as opaque.
parameters.name: cursor

parameters.description: `desc` (newest first, the default) or `asc` (oldest first). Keep the same order (and `sort`, where offered) while following `next_cursor`: changing it midway only changes where the next page starts.
parameters.name: order

parameters.description: `true` to also get `pagination.total`, the number of items matching the filters, on the first page (without `cursor`). Costs one more query; leave it out when not needed.
parameters.name: count

parameters.description: Language of the `detail` of errors: `en` (the default) or `vi`. Codes never change with the language.
parameters.name: Accept-Language

200.description: One page of the notes in your scope.

401.description: Not signed in; see `GET /api/v1/auth/me` for the codes.

403.description: Missing permission `notes.read`; code `permission_denied`. The tenant's plan does not include this module (`module_not_enabled`).

422.description: A paging parameter is invalid; see `errors`.

default.description: Any error, as RFC 9457 Problem Details. The `code` field identifies the problem.

get.description:
For offline apps (see `GET /api/v1/kernel/sync/resources`): each item is the note as it is
now, or `deleted` when it was deleted or left your scope. Keep the `cursor` of the last item you
applied and send it next time; an old cursor answers `410` (`sync_cursor_expired`): load the
list again. Requires `notes.read`; its scope decides which notes you get.

parameters.description:
The `cursor` of the last change you applied. Leave it out the first time: you get every
change the server still keeps (load the list endpoint first — changes carry the current
record, so applying one you already have is harmless).
parameters.name: cursor

parameters.description: Language of the `detail` of errors: `en` (the default) or `vi`. Codes never change with the language.
parameters.name: Accept-Language

default.description: Any error, as RFC 9457 Problem Details. The `code` field identifies the problem.
